milestones.description: Implement the perspective-divide projection function in parallax_engine/projection.py. The validator (tools/validate_projection.py) defines the locked API contract: project_points(x_centered, y_centered, z_cam, perspective_px, canvas_width, canvas_height) -> (x_screen, y_screen). Also implement project_world_points, the full §2.1 function that includes world-to-camera transform, for use by the renderer pipeline. Both must be pure vectorized NumPy with no Python loops over points.
acceptance_criteria: tools/validate_projection.py exits 0 — all 11 tests pass

Deterministic: byte-identical output on repeated calls with same input
tests/test_projection.py passes with pytest
milestones.notes: SPEC AMBIGUITY: validate_projection.py defines project_points with signature (x_centered, y_centered, z_cam, perspective_px, canvas_width, canvas_height) -> (x_screen, y_screen). SPEC.md §2.1 defines project_points with signature (points_xyz, cam, perspective_px, origin_xy) -> (s, screen_xy, z_cam). Resolution: implement the validator's simpler 'inner' function as project_points (validator contract is locked), and implement the full §2.1 pipeline as project_world_points.
